scopedShapeNotes.tag:icon: React accepts any ReactNode; Blazor supports named Icon strings and IconTemplate RenderFragments.
scopedShapeNotes.tag:classNames: React accepts an object or a props callback; Blazor currently accepts the semantic slot dictionary only.
scopedShapeNotes.tag:styles: React accepts an object or a props callback; Blazor currently accepts the semantic slot dictionary only.
scopedShapeNotes.tag:options: React options accept string or number values and ReactNode labels; Blazor CheckableTagOption currently uses string values and string labels.
scopedShapeNotes.tag:defaultValue: React values support strings, numbers, and arrays of either; Blazor supports string values or IReadOnlyList<string>.
scopedShapeNotes.tag:onChange: CheckableTag.onChange maps to CheckedChanged; CheckableTagGroup uses ValueChanged or ValuesChanged depending on Multiple.
scopedShapeNotes.dropdown:menu: Blazor DropdownMenuOptions supports data-driven items, groups, submenus, selection, activeKey, icons, state, and click callbacks; verify remaining React MenuProps fields separately.
scopedShapeNotes.dropdown:getPopupContainer: Blazor accepts Func<ElementReference, ElementReference> to select the popup parent; the callback intent matches React, with Blazor DOM-reference types.
scopedShapeNotes.dropdown:align: React accepts rc-trigger AlignType (points, offset, targetOffset, and overflow); Blazor currently exposes Placement and scalar offsets, so arbitrary alignment objects are not yet represented.
scopedShapeNotes.dropdown:autoFocus: React focuses the popup menu when opened; Blazor does not yet provide equivalent popup focus management.
scopedShapeNotes.button:classNames: React classNames accepts an object or a callback; Blazor exposes the object as ClassNames and the callback as ClassNamesFunc receiving the current Button instance.
scopedShapeNotes.button:styles: React styles accepts an object or a callback; Blazor exposes the object as Styles and the callback as StylesFunc receiving the current Button instance.
scopedShapeNotes.select:classNames: React classNames accepts an object or a props callback; Blazor exposes the semantic dictionary as ClassNames and a ClassNamesFunc callback receiving the current Select instance.
scopedShapeNotes.select:styles: React styles accepts an object or a props callback; Blazor exposes the semantic dictionary as Styles and a StylesFunc callback receiving the current Select instance.
scopedShapeNotes.select:onChange: React onChange uses one callback whose value shape depends on mode; Blazor exposes ValueChanged for single mode and ValuesChanged for multiple/tags mode.
scopedShapeNotes.select:prefixCls: React prefixCls is supplied through ConfigProvider in Blazor; Select does not expose a per-instance prefix override.
scopedShapeNotes.select:direction: Blazor accepts a per-Select Direction override and inherits ConfigProvider direction when omitted.
scopedShapeNotes.select:popupStyle: React popupStyle is represented by Blazor DropdownStyle.
scopedShapeNotes.select:showScrollBar: rc-select virtual-list scrollbar rendering option; Blazor virtualization does not expose this presentation flag.
scopedShapeNotes.select:choiceTransitionName: rc-select internal choice animation override; Blazor uses the shared component motion tokens.
scopedShapeNotes.select:getInputElement: React custom input rendering callback; Blazor Select currently owns its input markup.
scopedShapeNotes.select:getRawInputElement: React custom raw input rendering callback; Blazor Select currently owns its input markup.
scopedShapeNotes.select:animation: Legacy rc-trigger animation API; Blazor uses the Overlay motion configuration.
scopedShapeNotes.select:transitionName: Legacy rc-trigger transition API; Blazor uses the Overlay motion configuration.
scopedShapeNotes.select:popupAlign: React rc-trigger alignment object is represented by Placement and overlay boundary adjustment settings in Blazor; arbitrary AlignType offsets are not exposed.
scopedShapeNotes.select:builtinPlacements: React rc-trigger placement map is represented by Blazor Placement; custom placement maps are not exposed.
scopedShapeNotes.select:showAction: React trigger activation list is represented by Blazor AutoFocus/Open and pointer events; a configurable activation list is not exposed.
scopedShapeNotes.select:components: React virtual-list component injection API has no direct Blazor extension point.
scopedShapeNotes.select:backfill: React combobox backfill behavior is not part of the Blazor Select modes.
scopedShapeNotes.select:listItemHeight: React virtual-list row height tuning is fixed to the component option height in Blazor.

scopedShapeNotes.table:filteredValue: React filteredValue is a controlled list; Blazor supports DefaultFilteredValue for initialization and Filtered for the indicator, but not controlled per-column selected values.

scopedShapeNotes.table:dropdownPrefixCls: React prefix customization is supplied through ConfigProvider in Blazor.
scopedShapeNotes.table:columns: React passes a data array of column configs; Blazor declares columns with Column child components or ColumnDefinitions templates.
scopedShapeNotes.table:pagination: React pagination config is represented by Blazor page parameters and PaginationTemplate; see the Table API mapping notes.
scopedShapeNotes.table:rowSelection: React rowSelection config is represented by Blazor Selection/SelectionColumn parameters and callbacks rather than one object parameter.
scopedShapeNotes.table:scroll: React scroll config is split into Blazor ScrollX, ScrollY, and ScrollToFirstRowOnChange.
scopedShapeNotes.table:prefixCls: React prefixCls is supplied through ConfigProvider in Blazor.
scopedShapeNotes.table:direction: React direction is inherited from ConfigProvider direction in Blazor.
scopedShapeNotes.table:components: React can replace internal table elements; Blazor Table has no equivalent component override API.
scopedShapeNotes.table:expandIcon: React accepts a custom expand icon renderer; Blazor exposes expansion content and column placement but no icon renderer parameter.
scopedShapeNotes.table:summary: React summary receives current page data; Blazor uses declarative SummaryRow components and does not pass the current data to a callback.
scopedShapeNotes.table:sticky: Blazor exposes StickyOffsetHeader; React sticky offsetScroll and getContainer settings have no matching parameters.
scopedShapeNotes.table:expandedRowKeys: React expandedRowKeys is controlled state; Blazor exposes DefaultExpandedRowKeys and OnExpandedRowsChange without a controlled key parameter.
scopedShapeNotes.table:expandedRowRender: React expandedRowRender maps to Blazor ExpandTemplate with RowData context.
scopedShapeNotes.table:expandRowByClick: Blazor currently expands rows through the expand control and does not expose expandRowByClick.
scopedShapeNotes.table:childrenColumnName: React selects tree children by property name; Blazor accepts a TreeChildren accessor function.
scopedShapeNotes.table:expandable: React expandable config is represented by Blazor expansion parameters and callbacks; see the Table API mapping notes.
scopedShapeNotes.table:caption: React caption is not currently rendered by Blazor Table.
scopedShapeNotes.table:tailor: Low-level rc-table implementation option; it is not part of the Ant Design Table documentation API.
scopedShapeNotes.table:getContainerWidth: Low-level rc-table measurement callback; it is not part of the Ant Design Table documentation API.
scopedShapeNotes.table:measureRowRender: Low-level rc-table measurement renderer; it is not part of the Ant Design Table documentation API.
scopedShapeNotes.table:render: React render maps to Blazor CellRender using a CellData context; callback argument shapes differ.
scopedShapeNotes.table:onCell: The callback intent matches, but React receives record/index and Blazor receives a CellData object.
scopedShapeNotes.table:onHeaderCell: The callback intent matches, but React receives a column and Blazor supplies a parameterless attribute factory.
scopedShapeNotes.table:footer: React footer is a callback receiving current page data; Blazor FooterTemplate has no data argument and Footer is string-valued.
scopedShapeNotes.table:rowClassName: React rowClassName receives record/index; Blazor RowClassName receives a RowData object.
scopedShapeNotes.table:loading: React accepts Spin props as well as a boolean; Blazor Loading currently accepts only a boolean.
